title: Poverty headcount at $28/day prosperity line, India
sourceIndicatorId: PIP: India poverty headcount, $28.00/day prosperity line (2021 PPP)

metadata.provenance: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP), version 20250930 (2021 PPP), India national survey-year estimates.
metadata.method: Survey-year poverty headcount at the World Bank's $28/day prosperity line (2021 PPP), fill_gaps=false. This is the rich-country-standard line behind the brief's prosperity gap; it is the article's own 2021-PPP version of Roser/OWID's $30-a-day thought experiment.
metadata.caveat: A very high line by Indian standards: almost the entire population sits below it, so this measures how far India is from a rich-country floor, not extreme poverty.
